candidates.mastery_evidence: No progress row; studied Linear Dependence and Independence50426 accuracy0.7415, mass8.67 helps vocabulary but not learned determinant-zero practice.

candidates.mastery_evidence: learned=false, accuracy0.58485, mass1, assessment mass0. No basis to omit determinant-law practice.
